description: Dependency updates of Guildwork, see docs/quality/renovate.md (Feinentwurf 00 section 2.11).

lockFileMaintenance.description: Off: the package managers pick new transitive versions here, without the waiting time of minimumReleaseAge. Lockfiles change with the manifest update that needs them.

customManagers.description: Pinned binaries of tools/bootstrap/tools.toml (GitHub releases). Only version is updated; see the package rule of the group bootstrap binaries for the checksums.
Container images of tools/bootstrap/tools.toml, pinned by digest; tag and digest are updated together.

packageRules.description: Waiting time of 7 days for every update with a release date. config:best-practices sets 3 days for npm in a package rule, which beats the top level value.
One pull request for the non-major npm updates (package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, packageManager).
One pull request for the non-major updates of the Python tools (pyproject.toml, uv.lock).
One pull request for the non-major updates of the GitHub Actions, pinned by commit SHA with a version comment.
Node.js in .node-version and engines.node together; both must stay equal.
Python stays on 3.12 (.python-version, requires-python, the ScanCode image and requirements.txt are made for it).
Runner labels are fixed by allowed_runners in quality/ci/policy.toml.
Pinned binaries: Renovate cannot fill in the checksums, which are only ever copied from the vendor.
prBodyNotes: **Manual step before merging.** Renovate changed only `version` in `tools/bootstrap/tools.toml`. Copy the `sha256` of every platform from the vendor's published checksums of the new release, update `source` and `retrieved`, and check the license row in `docs/quality/toolchain.md`. Until then `make bootstrap` stops with `bootstrap.checksum_mismatch` and CI stays red.

packageRules.description: Container images of tools.toml: Renovate reads the new digest from the registry.
prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** update `retrieved` of the image table in `tools/bootstrap/tools.toml` and the tag in `docs/quality/toolchain.md`.

packageRules.description: The ScanCode environment is compiled with ScanCode's own pins as constraints; updating single packages breaks it.
ScanCode and pylibmagic only on approval from the Dependency Dashboard.
prBodyNotes: **Manual step before merging.** Renovate changed only `requirements.in`. Copy ScanCode's `requirements.txt` of the new tag into `constraints.txt`, compile `requirements.txt` with the command in its header (new `--exclude-newer` date), run `make scancode SCANCODE_RUNNER=local` and update `docs/quality/toolchain.md`.
